pages.title: Brewing Malice
pages.text: Place an Awkward Potion in a brewing stand and a Remnant Memory in the ingredient slot. Drink the Potion of Malice yourself, or use it on one of your own tamed, ordinary maids.

pages.title: Drinking Malice
pages.text: One bottle grants $(l:callresponse:combat/31_corrupted_hunt)Corrupted Pursuit$(/l) for 60 minutes. Each bottle you drink while the effect lasts adds one level, up to 255, and refreshes the full hour.

pages.title: Returning home
pages.text: A hunting party can appear when you come within 10 blocks of your personal respawn point in its dimension. A successful ambush consumes the effect. To avoid the pursuit, drink milk before returning.

pages.title: Giving it to a maid
pages.text: Your maid gains 20% attack damage and speed, and 1 Fear per minute. Extra doses keep the same combat bonuses. With AI dialogue enabled and her owner in the same dimension, she may answer a strange whisper about every five minutes.
